# Azure Arc SQL - Resource Reconciliation
**Version 1.2.6.** Personal, independent project; not an official Microsoft tool. See [disclaimer](https://github.com/fabiotreze/AzureArcBRTips/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md). Queries only read ARG; deploying/saving changes a workbook resource. This view lists technical exceptions and unresolved evidence, not confirmed orphan resources or licensing noncompliance.

# Azure Arc SQL - Reconciliação de recursos
**Versão 1.2.6.** Projeto pessoal e independente; não é ferramenta oficial da Microsoft. Veja o [aviso legal](https://github.com/fabiotreze/AzureArcBRTips/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md). As consultas apenas leem ARG; implantar/salvar altera um recurso de workbook. A visão lista exceções técnicas e evidências inconclusivas, não órfãos confirmados ou irregularidades de licenciamento.
Only missing or unexpected relationships are listed. Known Azure VM containers are excluded; absent parents remain candidates because their scope cannot be confirmed.
Somente relações ausentes ou inesperadas são listadas. Contêineres Azure VM conhecidos são excluídos; pais ausentes permanecem candidatos porque seu escopo não pode ser confirmado.

content.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
| where tolower(tostring(properties.containerResourceId)) !contains '/providers/microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/'
| extend expectedId=tolower(tostring(properties.containerResourceId))
| extend containerKind=case(isempty(expectedId),'Missing',expectedId contains '/providers/microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/','Arc Machine',expectedId contains '/providers/microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/','Azure VM','Other')
| join kind=leftouter (Resources | where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines') | project expectedId=tolower(id),foundId=id) on expectedId
| where isempty(foundId) or containerKind in ('Missing','Other')
| project id,category='Container',resourceName=name,serviceType=tostring(properties.serviceType),sqlVersion=tostring(properties.version),edition=tostring(properties.edition),sqlStatus=tostring(properties.status),provisioningState=tostring(properties.provisioningState),lastInventoryUploadTime=todatetime(properties.lastInventoryUploadTime),lastUsageUploadTime=todatetime(properties.lastUsageUploadTime),inventoryAgeDays=datetime_diff('day',now(),todatetime(properties.lastInventoryUploadTime)),resourceId=id,parentResourceId=expectedId,containerKind,finding=case(containerKind=='Missing','Missing containerResourceId',containerKind=='Other','Unknown container type','Container absent from ARG'),rpValidation='Pending',resourcePortalUrl=strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#resource',id),parentPortalUrl=iff(isnotempty(expectedId),strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#resource',expectedId),'')
| order by resourceId asc

| where containerId !contains '/providers/microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/'

content.json: Instances with a status other than Connected (the inventory upload timestamp is shown for context only, not judged), and SQL extensions (Windows or Linux) that report a non-Healthy status or upload problem (plugin-level statuses inside an otherwise Healthy message are not judged). Connection mode (direct, proxy, Private Link, gateway) is not judged as an exception. Instances whose Arc machine is absent appear in Relationships.

Instâncias com status diferente de Connected (o horário do último inventário é só contexto, não é julgado), e extensões SQL (Windows ou Linux) com status não Healthy ou problema de upload (status de plugin dentro de uma mensagem Healthy não é julgado). O modo de conexão (direto, proxy, Private Link, gateway) não é tratado como exceção. Instâncias sem máquina Arc aparecem em Relacionamentos.

| summarize projectionCount=count(),projectedServers=make_set(serverName),parentInstanceIds=make_set(instanceId),latestCollection=max(collectionTimestamp),primaryReplicas=make_set(primaryReplica),clusterTypes=make_set(clusterType),healthStates=make_set(synchronizationHealth),provisioningStates=make_set(provisioningState),resourceIds=make_set(id),missingHealth=countif(isempty(synchronizationHealth)),unrecognizedHealth=countif(isnotempty(synchronizationHealth) and synchronizationHealth !in ('HEALTHY','NOT_HEALTHY','PARTIALLY_HEALTHY')),missingPrimary=countif(isempty(primaryReplica)),missingProvisioning=countif(isempty(provisioningState)),failedProvisioning=countif(provisioningState =~ 'Failed') by correlationKey,availabilityGroupId,subscriptionId
| extend availabilityGroup=correlationKey
| extend hasUnhealthy=set_has_element(healthStates,'NOT_HEALTHY') or set_has_element(healthStates,'PARTIALLY_HEALTHY'),hasUnknownHealth=missingHealth>0 or unrecognizedHealth>0
| extend validationResult=case(isempty(availabilityGroupId),'Missing availabilityGroupId',hasUnhealthy,'AG reports unhealthy or partially healthy',failedProvisioning>0,'AG provisioning failed',missingProvisioning>0,'AG provisioning metadata missing',hasUnknownHealth,'AG health requires review',missingPrimary>0,'AG primary replica metadata missing',array_length(healthStates)>1,'AG health differs across projections',array_length(primaryReplicas)>1,'Primary replica differs across projections','AG projections consistent and health reported healthy')
| extend severity=case(validationResult=='AG projections consistent and health reported healthy','Info',validationResult=='AG reports unhealthy or partially healthy','Warning','Review')
| where severity != 'Info'
| extend rpValidation='Pending'
| project rpValidation,severity,availabilityGroup,availabilityGroupId,projectionCount,projectedServers,primaryReplicas,clusterTypes,healthStates,latestCollection,provisioningStates,validationResult,subscriptionId,parentInstanceIds,resourceIds
| order by severity desc,availabilityGroup asc

content.json:
## Validate before remediation
- Child and parent GET return 200: both exist; validate the relationship, not just existence.
- Child 200 and parent 404: strong candidate only after verifying ID, API version, permissions and scope.
- Both 404: possible stale ARG evidence.
- Any 403, timeout or transient failure: inconclusive.
Orphan candidates: an instance whose Arc machine is absent from ARG, and the databases and availability groups below it, which are dependent resources. Microsoft documents removing the SQL extension (WindowsAgent.SqlServer or LinuxAgent.SqlServer), the SQL Server - Azure Arc resource and dependent resources as separate steps; resources remaining after only the machine was removed was observed in a tested environment and is not documented here as a guarantee (verified on 2026-11-06: [disconnect SQL Server from Azure Arc](https://learn.microsoft.com/sql/sql-server/azure-arc/delete-from-azure-arc)).

No delete/update action is provided. Empty grids do not certify compliance. Do not publish credentials or environment exports.

Sources verified on 2026-11-06: [ARG strategy](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/governance/resource-graph/choose-query-strategy), [FCI](https://learn.microsoft.com/sql/sql-server/azure-arc/support-for-fci), [SQL license API](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/arcdata/sql-server-licenses/get).

## Validar antes de corrigir
- GET do filho e pai retornam 200: ambos existem; valide a relação, não somente existência.
- Filho 200 e pai 404: candidato forte somente após conferir ID, API, permissões e escopo.
- Ambos 404: possível evidência ARG desatualizada.
- Qualquer 403, timeout ou falha transitória: inconclusivo.
Candidatos a órfãos: instância cuja máquina Arc não existe no ARG e os bancos e grupos de disponibilidade abaixo dela, que são recursos dependentes. A Microsoft documenta a remoção da extensão SQL (WindowsAgent.SqlServer ou LinuxAgent.SqlServer), do recurso SQL Server - Azure Arc e dos recursos dependentes como etapas separadas; recursos que permanecem quando só a máquina foi removida foram observados em ambiente de teste e não são documentados aqui como garantia (verificado em 2026-11-06: [desconectar o SQL Server do Azure Arc](https://learn.microsoft.com/sql/sql-server/azure-arc/delete-from-azure-arc)).

Não há ação de exclusão/alteração. Grades vazias não certificam conformidade. Não publique credenciais ou exportações do ambiente.

Fontes verificadas em 2026-11-06: [estratégia ARG](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/governance/resource-graph/choose-query-strategy), [FCI](https://learn.microsoft.com/sql/sql-server/azure-arc/support-for-fci), [API de licenças SQL](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/arcdata/sql-server-licenses/get).
